BiblicalUsage: Hatipha heads a family of Nethinim, the temple servants who returned from exile with Zerubbabel. The name means seized, and the family is listed in both registers of the return.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God kept the temple servants on the rolls beside the priests. Hatipha's family came home to serve, and their name is written down twice.
